verdict.rationale: Brex documents a broad first-party API surface covering transactions, budgets and spend limits, expenses and receipt upload, payments and vendors, team management, travel, accounting, webhooks and an MCP server. However, nothing claims UI parity, and the evidence shows gaps: API tokens must be created in the dashboard, the Fields API supports only single-select dropdowns, and travel appears list-only. Missing for 10: an explicit UI-parity claim, API control of approval flows, policies and AI agents, programmatic token management, full Fields API support, and independent hands-on corroboration of coverage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The budgets API lets you manage your Brex Budgets and Spend Limits.
The payments API allows you to initiate and manage payments and vendors from your Brex business accounts.
Team API: Added update and delete endpoints for departments, locations, and titles.
The Fields API currently supports only single-select dropdown fields.
Sign in to dashboard.brex.com as an account admin or card admin... Click Create Token.
